put.description: Omit the body or send a null group_id to remove the session from its group.

schema.description: Use aside to list the groups beside the page.

416.description: The requested range is outside the file.

200.description: The full attachment. Only attachments stored in files can advertise byte ranges.

416.description: The requested range is outside the file.

get.description: Export the session and its children as ATIF v1.8.

425.description: The speech engine is not ready.
The job has not produced audio yet.

200.description: Whole attachment. A file reference can also answer a byte range; an inline attachment always answers the whole body.

416.description: The requested range is outside the file.

425.description: The transcription engine is not ready.

post.description: Import a .vissnap snapshot or an ATIF JSON document.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Query values are text. Send a typed value in the JSON body.

425.description: The speech engine is not ready.
The job has not produced audio yet.
The transcription engine is not ready.

proxy.description: The forward proxy of the gateway. A client sends a request for a matching host to `port` on the host of the gateway, with the gateway token as the user name of `Proxy-Authorization: Basic`.

web_launch.description: A one-time code that connects a browser to this gateway. `vis-agent web` puts it in the URL fragment.

web_launch_grant.description: What a redeemed launch code gives the browser: the gateway it reached and the token for its API.

health.description: The answer of /healthz and /readyz: the stable id of the gateway, its protocol and the machine name that its operator set. A gateway without a name omits machine_name. The answer also carries process counters that have no contract.

web_brand.description: The white label of the web app that this gateway serves. An absent key keeps the Vis default. A GET needs no token, because the app shows the brand before it connects.

name.description: The name beside the logo and in the page title.

logo.description: The picture of the brand: an `https://` address, a path of the web app, or a base64 `data:image/` URL of a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG picture.

href.description: The address that the logo opens.

links.description: The icon links of the header, in order.

web_brand_link.description: One icon link of the header. It opens in a new tab.

label.description: The accessible name and the tooltip of the link.

web_brand_theme.description: The only theme of the web app. While a brand has one, the app shows no theme choice. `base` names a theme that the app ships. `colors` replaces CSS variables of that theme.

oneOf.title: Cleared
oneOf.description: The user forgot the goal with /goal --clear. Clients show no goal, and the model does not see it. The record stays so that clients keep the highest revision.

iteration_budget.description: Maximum loop iterations for this goal; null means unlimited. Tokens are not a budget unit.

time_used_ms.description: Accumulated active wall-clock milliseconds through updated_at, including tools. While status is active, add max(0, now - updated_at) for the live duration. Inactive time is excluded; resume preserves this count and replacement resets it.

iterations_used.description: Completed model responses and their tools, including prose, empty responses and the response whose tools complete or block the goal. The final reply after that response is not counted. Provider retries within one request are not separate iterations.

session.description: The wire soul of one session: its stored record and its live gateway status. goal is null until an explicit /goal or SDK request creates it. List rows also carry unread_answers and is_unread. Search rows also carry match. GET with include=queued adds queued_turns and queue_paused.

agent_name.description: Coding-agent name resolved by the gateway from the session workspace configuration.

favorite_rank.description: A rank to compare, never to show. Null when the session has no star.

match.description: Why a search row matched the query. Only search rows carry it.

session_team.description: The subagents of a leader session. active counts the queued and running children; total counts all children. A subagent session has zero of each.

team_update.description: The payload of session.team_updated since protocol 21. team is the new summary of the leader. agents has the whole rows of the children that changed, in the row shape of subscription.ready agents. Since protocol 23, a step or Activity change of a child whose last pushed row the gateway knows that the clients have is in changes and not in agents. A lifecycle or request change, and the first change after 30 s without a whole row of that child, always comes as a whole row in agents. A client applies agents first: it replaces the row with the same session_id and appends a row with an unknown session_id at the end, which keeps spawn order. Then it applies each item of changes to the row with the same session_id. A repeated event gives the same rows. The stream of a subagent gets the part of its own team, as its subscription.ready frame gives its team: the rows, changes, team_clocks and removed of that team, and in team the summary of the subagent itself.

changes.description: Since protocol 23: the changed keys of the rows of children that a client has. Each item has the session_id and each key that changed, with its new value. A key with a null value went away, so a client removes it from the row. A client ignores an item with an unknown session_id: it gets the whole row with the next subscription.ready frame.

team_clocks.description: The stored clocks of the teams that changed: the leader turns of each rebuilt row. A client replaces its clock with the same turn_id and keeps each other clock. Absent when no clock changed.

removed.description: The session ids of the children that were deleted. A client removes the row of each such child from its team, also a row that it got with a transcript turn. team_clocks then has a clock for each leader turn of such a child: the stored clock, or a clock with worked_ms 0 when the team has no stored clock now. Absent when no child was deleted.

team_change.description: The change of one team row since the last row that the gateway pushed for that child. Each key other than session_id has a value of the agent row shape, or null when the key went away. Null and a missing key mean the same: the gateway sends a key that becomes null or goes away once as null, and a key that is null or missing in both rows not at all. A client removes a key with a null value from the row. A lifecycle or request change never comes as a change: it comes as a whole row in agents.

session_group_color.description: Closed palette token a session group is painted with. Every channel maps a token to its own theme, so a group keeps its identity across the TUI, the companion app and the web UI. Never a hex string.

session_groups.description: Head of an uncut, active list only: the live groups of every project.

session_group_page.description: Head of a grouped=aside list cut to one project: its page of groups in the same archive view and group window.

keybinding.description: One TUI key binding that an extension declares: the key after C-x runs a slash command, a built-in TUI verb or an extension function.

key.description: One printable ASCII character from ! to ~, the key after C-x.

command.description: A slash command line. The TUI runs it as if the person typed it and pressed Enter.

action.description: A built-in TUI verb id in kebab case, such as new-session. The verb moves to this key.

run.description: The key runs a function of the extension in the gateway. Run it with POST /v1/sessions/:sid/keybindings/run.

label.description: The hydra and palette label. Required with command and run.

group.description: The hydra heading. A command or run binding uses Extensions when it gives none.

extension.description: The name of the extension that declares the binding.

keybinding_run.description: The run binding that the person pressed: its extension, its declared group and its key.

keybinding_run_result.description: The result of one run binding. The function returns it, or the gateway reports its failure.

notification_event.description: A short notice that clients show as a toast. Extensions send it with vis.notify. A global notice goes live to every open session. A session notice waits in the gateway until a client opens its session, and then goes to that client once. A client keeps one toast for each notice_id: a later notice with the same id replaces it. The gateway never replays it.

keybinding_list.description: The TUI key bindings of the extensions of one session, in extension order, then declaration order.

upstream_status.description: HTTP status that the MCP authorization server answered at the failed step.

upstream_url.description: Authorization server URL that the failed step called.

input_tokens.description: Token count of the rejected per-question decision sequence, including state and question structure.

max_input_tokens.description: Configured encoder token limit for one decision question.

oneOf.description: Live only. A subagent of a leader changed: it started, took a step, opened or closed a request, ended or was cancelled. The payload has the team_update shape. child_id names the child that changed, when one did.
Live only, on the fleet feed. A setting changed. target names its owner and id names the setting, when one setting changed. A client reads its open settings again.

session_event_type.description: The closed vocabulary of session events. x-vis-payload names the $defs schema of the fields that an event of that type has after its envelope (schema, seq, ts, session_id and type).

decided_in.description: The closest wider scope that decides this inherited row. The row is read-only here.

is_set.description: Whether a secret row has a saved value. A secret row never carries the value itself.

suggestions.description: Values that an editor offers as completions. Other values can still be valid.

is_optional.description: A string row that accepts a blank value. A blank value removes the saved value.

lock_reason.description: Present when a client cannot change this row. The text tells a person why. A client shows the row read-only.

change_error.description: Present after a write when the owner's change hook or its storage write failed. The message says when the value is not saved.

parent.description: Id of the setting that this row belongs under.

children.description: Settings that belong under this row, in display order. Children can have children.

editor_options.description: Static data for the editor. A presets row carries presets_options. A model row carries none: its choices are the chat models of GET /v1/models.

project_extensions.description: Project extensions of the context session. Only Machine settings show them.

is_locked.description: Only for `agent_name`, with the value action. true saves the name and locks it: the gateway then answers 409 to a write without this key. false saves the name and removes the lock.

session_atif.description: An ATIF v1.8 trajectory from Vis.

session_snapshot_manifest.description: The manifest of a .vissnap session snapshot, readable without the engine.

attachment_reference.description: Keys that an iteration attachment descriptor adds when attach() keeps a reference to a file on the gateway machine instead of its bytes. attach() does this for a file that is larger than the attachment limit. The session database keeps no byte of the file. GET /v1/sessions/:sid/iterations/:iid/attachments/:idx streams the file from disk and answers Range requests. A client plays a recording or a clip from the content_url of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/fs/file?path=<path>, because a media element cannot send the gateway token. A client opens any other file from the content_url of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/iterations/:iid/attachments/:idx/link, for example in a frame or as a download.

path.description: The absolute path of the file on the gateway machine.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes when attach() recorded it.

attachment_link.description: The answer of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/iterations/:iid/attachments/:idx/link for an attachment that keeps a reference to a file on the gateway machine. A frame, a download link or another app cannot send the gateway token, so they open content_url. The route answers 409 attachment-not-reference for an attachment that has its bytes in the session database, 404 attachment-not-found for an unknown attachment and 404 attachment-file-missing when the file is gone.

content_url.description: The address of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/iterations/:iid/attachments/:idx for this attachment, relative to the gateway origin. Its expires and ticket query parameters authorize the request without a bearer token. The ticket names this session, this iteration and this index only. The route streams the file from disk and answers Range requests. Its Content-Disposition is inline. Add download=1 to the query to get attachment, so that a browser saves the file under its name. A wrong ticket gets 401 invalid-ticket, and a ticket after expires_at gets 401 ticket-expired.

expires_at.description: Epoch milliseconds after which the ticket in content_url is refused. Ask the link route again for a new address.

preview_image_bytes.description: Bytes of one picture in a file preview. The picture goes as base64 inside JSON, which is 4/3 larger, and a phone decodes it. A larger picture gets a 413 answer.

file_preview.description: The answer of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/fs/file. The kind tells what the file holds and which keys come back.

oneOf.title: Text
oneOf.description: One window of clipped lines around the line that the client named.

line.description: The line that the client named, or 1.

first_line.description: The number of the first line in lines.

is_truncated.description: True when the byte cap stopped the read before the window ended.

oneOf.title: Image
oneOf.description: A picture that a browser draws, typed by its first bytes, not by its file name.

data.description: The bytes of the picture as standard base64.

oneOf.title: Binary
oneOf.description: Another file with a NUL byte. The gateway does not read it.

oneOf.title: Media
oneOf.description: A recording or a clip that a browser plays, typed by its first bytes. A player reads it from content_url, which streams the file and answers Range requests.

content_url.description: The address of GET /v1/sessions/:sid/fs/file/content for this file, relative to the gateway origin. Its signed ticket authorizes the request without a bearer token, because a media element cannot send one. The ticket names this session and this file only.

expires_at.description: Epoch milliseconds after which the ticket in content_url is refused. Read the preview again for a new address.

presets_options.description: The editor options of a presets row. A preset gives one value to each slot.

slots.description: The parts of each preset, in display order.

builtin.description: Presets that Vis includes. They cannot change. Their ids are also valid slot values.

is_previewable.description: Whether POST /v1/settings/:id/preview can preview one slot value.

presets_value.description: The value of a presets row: the active preset and the presets of the person. active is a built-in id or a custom name.

slots.description: Slot id to value. The owner of the setting decides what a value means.

models_value.description: The value of a models row: chat models in order, each a provider and one of its models. An empty array names no model, and the description of the row tells what applies then.

setting_preview.description: Preview one slot value of a presets row before you save it.

turn_open_status.description: A turn record that still waits for settlement.

turn_execution_terminal_status.description: The final statuses of a turn that ran. A suspended turn can resume.

turn_settled_status.description: A turn status that ends a wait. Sent means the request went into another turn.

turn_council.description: The Council entry that started the turn. The note is plain text for display; content is the full entry.

turn.description: One turn of a session as the turn routes answer it. The engine can add fields.

session_block_request.description: One Python block to run in the session sandbox, as the `py3` tool of the agent runs it. No model is called.

session_block.description: The result of one block: the text that the agent sees. `is_error` is true when the block failed.

is_child.description: True creates a child of the session bound to the extension. Only an extension with a bound session can set this to true.

extensions.description: Usage of extension children at all depths.

subagents.description: Usage of Council subagents at all depths.

usage.description: The usage rollup, or null when the session has no turns and no extension children.

branch.description: Local branch to check out in the session workspace.
Checked-out branch; null when HEAD is detached or the workspace is not a git repository.

branches.description: Local branches, most recently committed first; empty outside git.

session_groups.description: With include=groups only: every group of the listed projects, archived ones included.

gateway_status.description: The gateway status map. The engine adds fields.

gateway_drain.description: Counts of the turns that a drain parked, forced and left running.

router_fleet.description: The provider fleet. A provider removal also gives is_removed. A selection change gives the default and fallback fields.

provider_auth.description: A provider sign-in step. `auth/start` answers the flow; `auth/poll` answers its verdict; `auth/complete`, `auth/cancel` and `logout` answer only a status.

oneOf.title: provider_auth_flow
oneOf.description: The flow that `auth/start` starts. `kind` is pkce, device or api-key.

oneOf.title: provider_auth_status
oneOf.description: The status of a sign-in step, with the poll message and the sign-in lines.

agents_route.description: The model that a subagent uses from its next request.

app_view.description: One app: the whole view, or the view deltas after the seq in `since`.

view_log.description: One bounded page of a log node.

agent_note.description: The page note that the model sees, or null when the note is blank.

record.description: The subagent record, only on request with include_record=true.

is_authorized.description: An HTTP server only: this machine has OAuth tokens for the server URL.

needs_auth.description: An HTTP server only: a connect asked for an OAuth sign-in, and no token is on file.

header_names.description: The names of the stored request headers. Values never leave the gateway.

env_names.description: The names of the stored environment variables. Values never leave the gateway.

mcp_server.description: One sanitized MCP inventory row. The row can also have command, args, cwd, url, timeout_ms, source and is_override.

needs_auth.description: The server answered with an OAuth Bearer challenge: save it, then sign in.

mcp_auth_flow.description: The wire view of one MCP sign-in flow.

mcp_token_status.description: The non-secret view of the stored OAuth tokens of one MCP server.

mcp_app_envelope.description: The bytes of an MCP App attachment (media type application/vnd.vis.mcp-app+json): the app that one tool call opened, as a surface hosts it. The MCP values in tool, arguments, result and csp keep their MCP spelling.

mcp_app_rpc_answer.description: The answer to one MCP request of a hosted MCP App view: the raw MCP result, or a JSON-RPC error that the host gives to the view.

app_door_answer.description: The live seam answer of an app door call. Its shape depends on the live operation in the envelope.

block_activity_payload.description: The payload of block.activity: one whole Activity snapshot of the form at form_index.

block_preview_payload.description: The payload of block.preview: the display fields of a tool call while the model writes it.

block_started_payload.description: The payload of block.started: the display fields of a form when it starts to run.

block_output_payload.description: The payload of block.output: the result of the form at form_index.

content_block_completed_payload.description: The payload of content.block.completed: the block with block_id has its final text.

content_block_delta_payload.description: The payload of content.block.delta: text adds to field of the block with block_id. offset is the UTF-16 start position of text in the block text.

content_block_started_payload.description: The payload of content.block.started: a new block of the turn. A presentation block arrives complete and names its iteration.

context_updated_payload.description: The payload of context.updated: the new context use of the session.

utilization.description: The context use of the session. The engine adds fields, so a client reads only the fields that it knows.

extensions_reloaded_payload.description: The payload of extensions.reloaded. A client skips a reload_id that it saw before.

iteration_completed_payload.description: The payload of iteration.completed: the settled thinking and prose of one iteration. presentation_content holds the typed records of a presentation iteration.

iteration_error_payload.description: The payload of iteration.error: the error of one iteration.

provider_limits_changed_payload.description: The payload of provider.limits_changed: a credential of provider_id changed, so its limits can be different. A client reads the limits again.

provider_retry_payload.description: The payload of provider.retry: the engine sends the provider request again after delay_ms.

queue_paused_payload.description: The payload of queue.paused: the queue holds held turns for reason.

queue_resumed_payload.description: The payload of queue.resumed. is_auto is true when the gateway resumed the queue without a person.

session_created_payload.description: The payload of session.created on the fleet stream.

session_deleted_payload.description: The payload of session.deleted. It has no fields.

session_goal_updated_payload.description: The payload of session.goal_updated. A null goal means that the session has no goal.

session_model_updated_payload.description: The payload of session.model_updated. reason is there only when a person did not choose the model.

session_status_payload.description: The payload of session.status on the fleet stream.

session_title_updated_payload.description: The payload of session.title_updated. titled_session_id is there when another session got the title.

settings_changed_payload.description: The payload of settings.changed: a setting of target changed. id names the setting when the writer knows it.

turn_terminal_payload.description: The payload of a terminal turn event. status is the end state of the turn. content has the settled blocks: a failed turn has all its blocks, other turns have only the prose, speech and leader stop blocks. error is the reason of a failed turn.

turn_input_payload.description: The payload of turn.input: queued messages that went into the running turn at iteration.

turn_progress_payload.description: The payload of turn.progress: what the turn does now. busy_ms, silent_ms and deadline_in_ms are clocks of a long wait.

transcription.description: The recording that the turn waits on: its position among the recordings without words, and the percent that is text already.

turn_queued_payload.description: The payload of turn.queued: a new turn waits in the queue.

turn_queued_deleted_payload.description: The payload of turn.queued.deleted: a queued turn left the queue and will not start.

turn_queued_drained_payload.description: The payload of turn.queued.drained: the queued turn left the queue to start.

turn_queued_sent_payload.description: The payload of turn.queued.sent: the queued turn went into the running turn into_turn_id.

turn_queued_updated_payload.description: The payload of turn.queued.updated: the whole new row of a queued turn.

notification_payload.description: The payload of a notification event: the fields after the envelope.

notice_id.description: The toast identity. A later notice with the same id replaces the shown toast.

title.description: One short bold line above the text.

duration_ms.description: How long the toast shows on screen. Without it, the client chooses by level.

scope.description: global: every open session shows the toast. session: only session_id shows it.

bus_topic.description: The topic of a signal: words of a-z, 0-9, '_' and '-', joined with '.'. Each extension has its own topics. The first word 'vis' is for the signals of Vis: only the gateway publishes them.

bus_pattern.description: The topics of one subscription: a topic in which '*' takes the place of one word. A last word '#' takes the place of zero or more words. Only a pattern whose first word is 'vis' gets the signals of Vis.

bus_scope.description: The subscribers that get a signal. 'global': each subscriber of the extension, in all sessions and in the global app. 'session': only the subscribers in the session of the publisher.

bus_data_bytes.description: The largest data of one signal, as JSON text in UTF-8 bytes.

bus_backlog.description: The signals that can wait for one subscriber. When more wait, the subscriber does not get the newest signal, and Vis logs a warning.

bus_signal.description: One signal that a subscriber gets. Delivery is in the gateway process, in publish order for each subscriber.

data.description: The JSON data that the publisher gave.

bus_vis_signal.description: A signal of Vis: the topic and the data. Only the gateway publishes it, with the scope 'global'.

bus_automation_changed.description: The data of 'vis.automation.changed': the stored automations or their due work changed. 'automation_id' names the automation when only one changed.

bus_automation_run.description: The data of 'vis.automation.run.<status>': one run of an automation got a new status. The last word of the topic is that status.

bus_session_deleted.description: The data of 'vis.session.deleted': Vis deleted this session.

subscription_ready_payload.description: The payload of subscription.ready: the fields after type and session_id.

tasks.description: All session Task rows at tasks_seq. Ignore older Task events after this snapshot.

tasks_seq.description: Sequence of the Task snapshot, independent of the replay cursor.

agents.description: Since protocol 22: the team rows of the session at the time of this frame. For a leader, each child that it started. For a subagent, each member of its team. Absent when the session has no team. A client replaces its team rows with these rows, then applies each session.team_updated after this frame.

team_clocks.description: The stored clock of each team of the session at the time of this frame: for a leader, one for each leader turn in which a child worked. For a subagent, the clock of its team. Absent when the session has no team. A client replaces its clocks with these clocks, then applies the team_clocks of each session.team_updated after this frame.

anyOf.description: The program that created the session. session_id is the session bound to the extension, absent for a global extension.

session_agent.description: The agent context of the session: a leader, or a subagent with its task, budget and file grant.

queue_paused_marker.description: The live hold of the turn queue: held turns wait for reason.

session_created.description: The answer of POST /v1/sessions: the new session id and the values that made it. Read GET /v1/sessions/:sid for the full session.

router_selection.description: Both router tags. A role is null where it has no tag.

router_patch.description: The answer of PATCH /v1/router: both router tags for the primary and fallback roles, or the provider fleet for the thinking role.

protocol_info.description: The protocol numbers and build of the gateway.

session_model_pair.description: A provider and model pair, or null when the session follows the router default.

voice_live_limits.description: The bounds of a live voice session. Each client reads them from the gateway.

voice_live_capabilities.description: The answer of the live voice capabilities route. reason says why voice is not available. enabled is always true.

voice_live_receipt.description: The result of one spoken request. turn_id and status name the admitted turn. error says why there is no turn.

voice_live_start.description: The answer to a live voice start. ticket opens media_path one time.

voice_live_snapshot.description: The state of one live voice session and the result of each spoken request.

voice_live_closed.description: The answer to a live voice close.

voice_utterance_payload.description: The payload of voice.utterance: the final transcript of one utterance, before admission.

voice_admission_payload.description: The payload of voice.admission: the result of one spoken request.

voice_speech_payload.description: The payload of voice.speech: one speech segment of a turn starts. The sample counts start at zero.

voice_playback_payload.description: The payload of voice.playback: the sample counts of one speech segment when it ends. reason says why it ended.

voice_input_overflow_payload.description: The payload of voice.input_overflow: the gateway refused one input operation because its queue was full.

speech_committed_payload.description: The payload of speech.committed: one conversation block of a turn is final text for speech. source_start and source_end are its range in the answer.

speech_invalidated_payload.description: The payload of speech.invalidated: the speech text of a turn is not valid because the answer changed.
